items.quote: And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.
items.claim: Isaac traveled to Gerar to meet Abimelech, king of the Philistines

items.quote: And there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham.
items.claim: A famine occurred in the land during Isaac's time, following a prior famine in Abraham's era
